title: Tokyo Revengers
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Takemichi Hanagaki, a 26-year-old with a dead-end life, learns his middle-school girlfriend was killed in a gang dispute. When pushed onto train tracks he leaps twelve years back in time, and he repeatedly travels between eras trying to change the Tokyo Manji Gang's violent future and save her.
life_message: It holds up never giving up on the people you love, even when you are weak and afraid.

content.note: Gang fights, ambushes, brutal retaliation and murders (Wikipedia; AniList Gore signal, Gangs 97%, Crime).

Teen gang culture, motorcycles and fighting presented as cool (Wikipedia; AniList Delinquents 99%).
